about: Vectors for an agent's source tree (DEC-0149), written by tools/vectors/source-tree.ts, never by hand. `tree`: sourceTreeProblems({manifest, files, instanceStrings?}) answers each place the instance shows through as {kind, file?, line?, column?, entry?, include?} (a file marked nestedRepository: true is a folder holding another repository, a submodule's gitlink or its own .git, read by its path only; a file marked link: true is a symbolic link whose text is its target, link-outside when that target is absolute, climbs above the root or is no source path, and never a licence): file is the index in files; a finding in a file's path has no line; line and column count from 1, the column in UTF-16 code units where the match begins (for a home path, where its name begins). Blocking kinds (FAC-SEM-158): home-path (a home folder with a name, in the forms and with the neutral names of the Fabric Agent Adapter's check; ~ never), credential (a value shaped like one, or a file that is one by its name), binary (not listed in binaries), nested-repository (a nested repository no exclude path names), instance-string (an entry of the operator's list, without regard to case under Unicode simple case folding, the entry and the text each also in NFC: as written, percent-encoded, form-encoded with + for a space, JSON-escaped, JSON-escaped with \/ for /, or JSON-escaped with every character outside ASCII as \uXXXX), missing (an include path with no file), short-instance-string, no-include. Warnings (FAC-SEM-159): email (not in publicAddresses, not at an RFC 2606 name), link-outside (a relative Markdown link, or a symbolic link, whose target is not source; a link's target is read literally), no-license. Problems come in the order: the list's refused entries, then no-include, then each file in order (its path, then each line: home-path, credential, instance-string, email, link-outside), then missing, then no-license. A file that is not source (outside include, inside exclude, in .git) is not read; a .git segment is read as Git's is_hfs_dotgit and is_ntfs_dotgit read it (ASCII case folded, the code points HFS+ ignores removed, trailing dots and spaces dropped, or GIT~1), and paths are compared in Unicode NFC. `patches`: patchPathsAllowed(manifest, paths) answers the paths that are not source, in the order given, and a path that under ASCII case folding an exclude entry names.

constants.about: The constants a port of the tree check holds equal to the reference's, written from src/source-rules.ts's exports (test/source-rules.test.ts holds the block to them): the neutral home names, the synthetic words, the home-folder patterns, the credential-file name patterns, the tree check's own provider-key shapes (KEY_SHAPE_SOURCES, unbounded, kept apart from the shared detector) and the URL rule's pattern (URL_SECRET_VALUE), each pattern as its source and flags.
